domain: Synthetic river states, two active players, exact uniform-opponent showdown equity; no action EV
limitations: Three CPU seeds; no GPU or multi-machine training
Card-order and suit invariance tested; no hidden/future features
model: MLP and canonical pooled card encoders
promotion: Research artifacts only; no automatic release. See per-model support, quality and baseline gates.

protocol.interpretation: Larger local research, not a multi-machine benchmark. No threshold changes after inspecting results. A failed model remains unpromoted. Holdem neural strategy is conditional on the small-game quality gate.
